questions.question: Jesus told some scribes and Pharisees who demanded a sign that no sign at all would be given to them. True or false?
Jesus said the Son of Man would be in the heart of the earth as long as Jonah was in the great fish. True or false?
Why did Jesus say the men of Nineveh will condemn the wicked generation at the judgment?

answers.text: They repented at the preaching of Jonah
They gave Jonah great gifts of silver
They sent Jonah back home in peace

questions.question: When Jesus' mother and brothers waited outside, who did He say is His brother and sister and mother?

answers.text: Whoever does the will of His Father
Whoever was born into His family
Whoever lives in His own hometown
